spans.s:
n. (-नं)
The flight of a bird, or a peculiar mode of flying.
E.
नि affirmative prefix, and डीन flight, flying.

mn. (-डः-डं)
1 A nest.
2 A place, a spot.
E.
नि before इङ् to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-जः)
A bird in general.
E.
नीड a nest, and ज born.

m. (-वः)
A bird.
E.
नीड a nest, and उद्भव born.
